# themes — the eight hashtags of the fixture brand

The theme dictionary the test engine listens for and drafts under. The shape
is the one `scripts/memory.py` reads from `.atelier/memory/themes.md`: a
dictionary table, then a licence table under `## licence and layer`, joined by
hashtag; a tag in one and not the other is an error. Written 2026-11-05 as a
fixture; the themes are invented.

| hashtag | what it is | why it is different | fact it links back to | partner tags | intro post |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #ExampleTheme | Who issues the root a credential chains to | A governance question, not a wallet feature | C-acme-4 | none cleared (@examplestandards cite only) | drafted |
| #SecondTheme | Settlement between vetted parties as a closed set | The set is the product, not the ledger | C-acme-5 | @betalabs on the cleared list only | — |
| #ThirdTheme | Accountability as a property of the record | Answerable, not merely auditable | C-acme-1 | none cleared | — |
| #FourthTheme | Currency rails that keep the rules of the currency | The rule travels with the money | C-acme-2 | none cleared | — |
| #FifthTheme | Compute a jurisdiction can account for | Where the machine is matters | C-acme-10 | none cleared | — |
| #SixthTheme | Automation inside existing law | The law is the spec | C-acme-3 | none cleared | — |
| #SeventhTheme | Agents that carry a mandate | Delegation that can be checked | — | none cleared | — |
| #EighthTheme | Open standards over private registers | A public standard outlives a vendor | — | none cleared | — |
